title: Rebuild flows and access after migration
subtitle: After a tenant move, reconnect flow steps and remap permissions in the destination tenant.

steps.title: Old tenant references break
steps.evidence: Power Automate connection references point to the old tenant and break after migration.

steps.title: Sign in again to each flow step
steps.evidence: Developers must sign in again and reconnect each trigger and action.

steps.title: Remap destination permissions
steps.evidence: Administrators must deliberately map and rebuild access in the destination environment.
